tweetText: Google's new ad imagines the Founding Fathers using AI tools to draft the Declaration of Independence. This highlights how technology could have changed historical events and sparks conversations about AI's role in creativity. via TechCrunch AI
Midjourney is pushing Hollywood studios to disclose their AI usage in an ongoing legal battle. This could set important precedents for transparency in the entertainment industry. via TechCrunch AI

Alibaba has banned employees from using Claude Code, labeling it as high-risk software. This move highlights growing concerns over AI tools and their implications for workplace security. via TechCrunch AI

Mistral AI, an OpenAI competitor, has secured major funding to develop open source AI models since its 2023 launch. This is important as it aims to make advanced AI accessible to everyone. via TechCrunch AI

Fanfiction communities are cracking down on writers using AI tools, but their detection methods are shaky and could mistakenly target innocent authors. This internal conflict highlights the growing tension between creativity and technology in fan culture. via The Verge AI
